deadline.value: International applicants should apply by mid-January; the program listing shows January 15, 2027 for Fall 2027. Later applications may be accepted only if positions remain.

also.quote: International student applications should be submitted by the middle of January

app_fee.value: CAD 140, non-refundable, payable by Visa, Visa Debit or MasterCard.
app_fee.quote: is $140 Cdn, payable by Visa, Visa Debit, or MasterCard. The application fee is non-refundable

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject requirement stated on the pages checked.

supervisor.value: No offer is made unless a faculty member agrees to supervise you. You may apply before securing one, but international applicants must have a supervisor secured before they can be considered for an offer.
supervisor.quote: No student is made an offer of admission unless a faculty member first agrees to supervise that student.

also.quote: you must have secured a supervisor before you can be considered for an offer

funding.value: Biology PhD has a standard funding package for international students (CAD 44,180 per year for years 1-5), but the program admits only a limited number of international students, competitively on merit.
funding.quote: Package Total 44,180 Annual Funding Summary Years 1 - 5

also.quote: due to funding constraints we can accept only several MSc and PhD international students per year

entry_route.value: PhD entry needs a master's degree in biological science (or a medical degree); MSc students may be advanced to the PhD after 12-16 months.
entry_route.quote: Graduates from a recognized university with a master’s degree or equivalent in biological science, with at least a B average (73-76%), or with a medical degree, may be admitted as candidates (PhD I)

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 90-91 (tests before January 2026) or 5 on the new scale (from January 2026), per the program listing.
toefl_min.quote: Minimum TOEFL (Internet-based) 90-91 (for tests taken prior to January 2026) or 5 (January 2026 and after)

notes: Three specializations: cell and molecular biology, animal and plant physiology, ecology and evolution.
